  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative signals (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to neutral/negative, especially after high peaks.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment swings; lagged sentiment (e.g., 3-5 day average) should guide correction.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., >10% below), reduce next period’s forecast by 5-15% to align with historical underperformance patterns.",
    "When sentiment is positive but forecast is overoptimistic, apply a 5-10% downward adjustment to prevent overcorrection."
  ]
}
